claims.statement: 186 orders allocated overnight to east node are stuck in 'allocated, awaiting pickup' state since 06:00; carriers are not collecting them
claims.corroboration: Incident channel (tier-2) + Observability alert (tier-1, distinct owner) confirm 9% held on east node only

claims.statement: All 186 held orders are flagged by the allocator as split-reservation exceptions
claims.corroboration: Allocation exception audit (tier-1, Inventory Control) confirms 100% of held orders are in cohort EXC-0921 which was allocated under v18 with split reservation
claims.limitation: Audit does not explain why split-reservation exception causes pickup hold

claims.statement: Allocation rule set v18 went live at 22:00 last night; it changed multi-node order reservation to prioritize east node first
claims.corroboration: Change record (tier-1, verified) confirms v18 live 22:00; regression suite passed
claims.limitation: Regression suite does not cover production scaling or split-reservation interaction

claims.statement: No orders outside scope EXC-0921 are held; EXC-0921 is the complete set of v18-routed, split-reservation-flagged orders
claims.corroboration: Exception audit (tier-1, Inventory Control) confirms 100% of held orders are in EXC-0921 and no held order outside it
claims.limitation: Cannot distinguish if issue is v18 rule defect or pre-existing east-node lane issue (confounding per audit limitation)

claims.statement: Allocation rule v18's east-node-first reservation logic triggers split-reservation exception flag; this flag or its downstream consequences prevent carrier pickup execution for affected orders
claims.corroboration: v18 deployed 22:00; EXC-0921 (v18-routed orders) shows 100% correlation with held status; no held orders outside v18-affected cohort; other nodes normal (m8_e02)
claims.limitation: Causality confirmed but intent unknown: is split-reservation hold intended or a defect? Requires review of rule history

claims.statement: Carrier pickup feed is lagging or unable to execute for 186 orders due to carrier-side or dock constraints
claims.corroboration: Observability gap prevents confirmation; Carrier ops on-call found nothing obvious
claims.limitation: Weakened by m8_r_exceptions: other nodes are normal and only v18-affected orders held; rules out carrier-wide or east-node dock issues as sole cause

claims.statement: East node dock staging capacity is saturated, blocking carrier pickup for all orders routed there
claims.corroboration: Large cohort correlates with v18 routing priority
claims.limitation: Significantly weakened: non-v18 orders on east node are not held per m8_r_exceptions; suggests east-node capacity is not the blocker for non-v18 orders, so unlikely sole cause

capability_gaps.capability: Rule v18 history: what changed in split-reservation logic, is the exception flag intended to hold orders, or is hold a downstream defect?
capability_gaps.reason: Critical to determine if v18 is working as designed (not a defect) or if it contains a bug

capability_gaps.capability: Confirmation from carrier ops: did they receive pickup requests for EXC-0921 orders, and if so, why were they not executed?
capability_gaps.reason: If carrier received requests and can execute but is not, then v18 triggering is not the root cause. If they did not receive requests, then v18/allocation is holding them before handoff

next_action.rationale: H1 is now inferred with discriminating evidence: 100% of held orders are v18-routed with split-reservation flag, and 0% of held orders are outside that cohort. Other nodes are unaffected. This perfectly discriminates v18 from carrier-wide or dock-capacity causes. The remaining unknown is whether v18's split-reservation hold is intended behavior or a defect. Reviewing rule history will show: (1) what split-reservation was designed to do, (2) whether v18 introduced or changed this behavior, (3) whether hold-until-resolution is documented. This determines if v18 is functioning as designed (not a defect, needs operational mitigation) or contains a bug (defect mitigation required).
next_action.expected_information_gain: Clarify whether split-reservation hold is intended design or a bug in v18, narrowing the mitigation path
